summary: From battle round 3, on the first use select a Trap objective outside the enemy deployment zone. This phase, add 1 to this unit’s ranged Wound rolls against enemies within control range of that objective. The Trap designation lasts the battle. Source conflict: the imported effect differs from the pinned snapshot; confirm the current first-use and objective procedure.

After the selected KROOT unit attacks, select one enemy it hit. Friendly KROOT models improve AP by 1 against that enemy this phase unless their attacking unit is Battle-shocked. The core target must not already have shot or fought before this use. Source review: the core selection requires a unit that has not attacked, while the effect triggers after attacks; confirm whether selection occurs before the attack and the mark resolves afterward.

In your Command phase, select one friendly KROOT or VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 12″ of the bearer. Improve its Leadership and Objective Control by 1 until your next Command phase. KROOT models cannot take this enhancement.
This Broadside Battlesuits unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds only.
Subtract 1 from incoming ranged Wound rolls against this Commander Shadowsun unit.

In the Shooting phase, re-roll this Kroot Lone-spear unit’s failed Hit rolls. Source review: the scope says this turn but supplies no activation event; confirm whether this is a standing benefit or an activated one.
After this Manta shoots in your Shooting phase, mark one enemy it hit. Friendly models that disembarked from this Manta this turn re-roll Wound rolls against that enemy this phase.
Use before the selected T’au unit has moved. When it Advances this phase, do not roll; add 6″ to its models’ Move characteristic instead.
This Commander Shadowsun model may shoot after Falling Back.

Multiply by three the CP cost of a Stratagem targeting this Manta. Source review: this is explicitly carried from a provisional source; confirm its current cost interaction and the core cost-modification rules.
At the end of your opponent’s turn, this Vespid Stingwings unit may enter Strategic Reserves if it is not engaged.

When the friendly KROOT or VESPID STINGWINGS unit Advances, it may still declare a charge. Source review: the source grants a charge permission without an explicit Advance exception and ends it at phase end, before the Charge phase; confirm the intended duration.
Add 1 to this Hammerhead Gunship model’s Hit rolls against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets.

When the hidden PATHFINDER TEAM or STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit is targeted in your opponent’s Shooting phase, improve its Save by 1 this phase. Source review: the approximate community note says the hidden gate was omitted, while the effect now includes it; confirm the current rule.
This Ghostkeel Battlesuit model may shoot after Falling Back and loses the SMOKE keyword.
This Riptide Battlesuit model may shoot after Falling Back.

Missing source mechanics: Battlesuit Support System for the Coldstar and Enforcer Commanders contains only a no-effect marker. Do not substitute the Ghostkeel or Riptide versions without checked wording.
This Crisis Starscythe Battlesuits unit may shoot after Falling Back.

Source review: Bodyguard is approximate. Its note permits two non-duplicate Leaders for a Kroot Carnivores unit of Starting Strength 20 and separates surviving Leaders when it is destroyed; the effect only encodes an unconditional attachment maximum of two. Confirm size, uniqueness and separation before building attachments.
Friendly T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT models gain +1 ranged Strength against defenders within 12″ and also +1 AP within 8″. The source marks Bonded Heroes provisional; confirm current ranges and benefits.
While the bearer leads a unit, its models’ melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

At the start of battle, select one enemy as this Kroot Farstalkers unit’s bounty target. Its attacks against that enemy gain Lethal Hits and Precision. Source review: the designation applies to attackers-of-target but the benefit targets this-unit without binding the attacking unit; confirm beneficiaries before sharing it with other units.
This Sudden Dawn Cadre Breacher Team re-rolls ranged Wound rolls against defenders within control range of an objective marker.
This Breacher Team re-rolls ranged Wound rolls against defenders within control range of an objective marker.

Once per battle per army, when a friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE unit is selected to shoot, mark one enemy. Friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE attacks against that enemy improve AP by 1 for the rest of the battle.
While the Coldstar Commander leads a unit, set that unit’s Move to 12″ and give its ranged weapons Assault.

After disembarking this turn, this unit re-rolls Wound rolls this phase only against the closest enemy unit. Source review: the closest-enemy gate appears in the note but is missing from the effect; confirm before applying the re-rolls.

Just after an enemy declares a charge against this unit, it may embark in a friendly TRANSPORT if every model is within 3″ and capacity permits. Source review: the approximate effect does not bind the charge target or encode transport capacity; confirm the full embark procedure.
When a friendly T’AU EMPIRE unit within 6″ of this Shadowsun model is targeted by a friendly Stratagem, roll D6; on 5+, gain 1CP. Apply core CP-gain limits.

Use on a unit just selected as an Observer. Its attacks against its Spotted unit improve Ballistic Skill by 1; if the Observer has MARKERLIGHT, those attacks also gain Ignores Cover this phase. Do not give this bonus against unrelated Spotted targets.

While the bearer leads a unit and that unit observes, a Guided unit’s ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1 against their Spotted target. KROOT SHAPER models cannot take this. Source review: the approximate effect does not bind the Guided unit to that Observer; confirm the pairing.
At the end of your Command phase, roll D6 for this Ethereal model; on 4+, gain 1CP. Apply core CP-gain limits.

While this Ta’unar model is Guided, its unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 against its Spotted target. Source review: this provisional source triggers only after attacks resolve, too late for those attacks; confirm timing and beneficiary.
When the friendly T’au unit is targeted in your opponent’s Shooting phase, reduce Damage allocated to it by 1 this phase. Apply the core minimum Damage rule.
In the Shooting phase, set this Cadre Fireblade unit’s ranged AP to 3 on Critical Wounds. This sets AP rather than adding 3 or automatically granting Devastating Wounds.
At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy within 12″ of this Piranhas unit; it takes a Battle-shock test.

This Tidewall Droneport model must target every eligible target with drone defenders in the Shooting phase. Source review: the provisional effect does not encode how many times to fire or how attacks are allocated among those targets; confirm the complete procedure.

Place a Drone token for the Sudden Dawn model. If its unit has a shield-drone, add 1 to this model’s Wounds. Source review: the condition checks unit wargear rather than the equipped model; confirm which models receive the wound and token.

Drone wargear branches: guardian-drone gives -1 incoming ranged Wound; gun-drone and missile-drone grant weapon references; marker-drone gives MARKERLIGHT and permission to Observe after Advancing; shield-drone adds 1 Wound to this model. Source review: confirm model-level equipment recipients, token handling and missing weapon profiles before applying all branches.

After Remaining Stationary, the Shas’ui gains the support turret weapon until the start of your next turn according to the note. Source review: the effect uses this-model, lacks the weapon profile and instead expires at the next Command phase; confirm recipient, timing and duration.

Earth Caste Modifications describes suppressing one enemy hit after shooting for -1 Hit until your next turn, plus Ingress setup more than 6″ from enemies with no charge that turn. Source review: its approximate effect omits the activation triggers and uses battle-wide scope for both; confirm duration and setup procedure.
When an enemy VEHICLE within 8″ of the selected friendly KROOT GRENADES unit is selected to shoot or fight, worsen that enemy’s Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill by 1 this phase.
While this Enforcer Commander leads a unit, worsen incoming ranged AP against that unit by 1.

While the bearer leads a unit, Patient Hunter begins for that unit in battle round 2 instead of round 3. KROOT SHAPER models cannot take this. Source review: Patient Hunter itself is provisional; verify its current benefits before applying the earlier start.

While the bearer leads a unit, Killing Blow also applies to it during battle round 4. KROOT SHAPER models cannot take this. Source review: Killing Blow itself is provisional; verify its current benefits before applying the extra round.

This Twin Lance unit’s ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1 and Ignores Cover against the closest eligible target. Source review: the source is explicitly marked partial; confirm any omitted restrictions before use.
When the friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit is selected to shoot, choose +1 ranged Strength this phase, or +1 ranged Strength and AP together with Hazardous.
When the friendly KROOT or VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to attack in Shooting or Fight, improve its AP by 1 this phase.

In your Shooting phase, the selected friendly PATHFINDER TEAM or STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit does not lose hidden status from those attacks. Source review: this is provisional; confirm the hidden-state rule and event binding.

When a friendly T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model in this unit is destroyed, before removal: if it has Deadly Demise, choose its roll as 1 or 6; otherwise roll D6 for each unit within 6″ and deal D3 mortals on each 4+. Source review: the approximate record uses this-model instead of binding the casualty; confirm the model and explosion procedure.
While this Ethereal model leads a unit, that unit has Feel No Pain 5+.
At the end of your Command phase, a friendly-controlled objective within this Kroot Carnivores unit’s control range becomes sticky.

After shooting in your Shooting phase, this Kroot Lone-spear unit may make a 6″ Normal move if unengaged and cannot declare a charge this turn. Source review: the no-charge branch targets this-model rather than the moving unit; confirm its scope.

This Crisis Fireknife unit re-rolls ranged Hit rolls of 1 against targets below Starting Strength; against targets not below Starting Strength, re-roll any ranged Hit rolls. Keep these source branches distinct.

In battle rounds 1–3, at the start of your Shooting phase, select two different friendly T’au units that have not shot and one enemy. Both friendly units must attack only that enemy this phase and improve AP by 1 against it.
Missing source mechanics: the Sudden Dawn Cadre For the Greater Good record contains only a no-effect marker. Check its own rules rather than silently copying the ordinary army rule.

Source conflict: For the Greater Good’s effect grants +1 Hit and unconditional Ignores Cover against a SPOTTED target, while its note calls this a Ballistic Skill benefit and assumes an Observer sacrifices shooting. The Observer/Guided selection procedure, pairing, MARKERLIGHT gate and other targeting restrictions are missing. Confirm the complete army rule before resolving it.
In the Shooting phase, subtract 1 from incoming Hit rolls against this Tidewall Fortification unit.

Forward Observers encodes Hit and Wound re-rolls of 1 against a SPOTTED target, but assigns them to this Stealth unit and also triggers after attacks. Source review: this partial source does not bind the supported Guided unit or Observer pairing; confirm beneficiaries and timing.

When an enemy declares a charge, the Sudden Dawn Pathfinder record subtracts 2 from this-unit’s Charge roll. Source conflict: that recipient is the defending unit rather than the charging enemy, and the charge-target binding is absent. Confirm the intended recipient.

The Pathfinder Grav-inhibitor Drone subtracts 2 from the defender’s Charge roll. Source conflict: the intended charging attacker is not bound, and the provisional source has no trigger. Confirm the enemy recipient and charge-target gate.

This equipped model gains the twin-pulse-carbine-drone weapon. Source gap: the provisional record supplies no weapon profile; confirm all characteristics and abilities.

During Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves, this Stormsurge model may move through non-TITANIC models and terrain up to 4″ high. The effect is attached to move-ended; confirm that the permission applies during the move and apply normal ending-position restrictions.

When the selected friendly KROOT unit is targeted, ranged attackers must be within 18″ to select it this phase. Source review: the note says only within 18″, but the effect encodes a positive permission without an explicit prohibition outside that distance; confirm the targeting restriction.
